d:
Mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ko bihar vidhanasbha se notis jari huaa hai. parti virodhi gatividhiyon men shamil hone ke mamle men yah ekshan liya gaya hai. kuchh dinon pahle jediyu ki or se shikayat ki gaee thi. ab isi mamle men vidhanasbha ke sachiv sanjay kumar ki or se anant sinh ko notis jari huaa hai.
